description: A PostHog batch export: a scheduled export of events, persons, sessions or a HogQL query to a destination such as S3, Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, Redshift, Databricks or Azure Blob Storage.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the batch export belongs to.

Name.description: Human-readable name for the batch export.

Model.description: Which data model to export: `events` (the PostHog default), `persons`, `sessions`, or `hogql` (the results of HogqlQuery).

Interval.description: How often the batch export runs.

Paused.description: Whether the batch export is paused.

DestinationType.description: Destination type. Cannot be changed after creation.

DestinationIntegrationId.description: ID of the team-scoped PostHog integration that provides the destination's credentials (aws-s3, s3-compatible, snowflake, postgresql, aws-redshift, google-cloud-service-account, databricks or azure-blob kind). PostHog requires it for every destination type.

DestinationConfig.description: Non-secret destination settings as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). Fields depend on DestinationType, e.g. AwsS3: {"bucket_name", "region", "prefix", "file_format", "compression", ...}; Snowflake: {"database", "warehouse", "schema", "table_name", "role"}; Postgres/Redshift: {"database", "schema", "table_name", ...}; BigQuery: {"dataset_id", "table_id"}.

DestinationSecretConfig.description: Secret destination settings (credentials such as aws_secret_access_key, password or private_key) as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString with dynamic references). Merged into the destination config on create and update. Write-only: never returned by Read. Prefer DestinationIntegrationId, which keeps credentials in a PostHog integration.

HogqlQuery.description: HogQL SELECT query whose results are exported when Model is `hogql`. May reference the {data_interval_start} and {data_interval_end} placeholders.

HogqlModifiers.description: HogQL modifiers for the query as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"convertToProjectTimezone": true}. Only supported when Model is `hogql`.

PrimaryKey.description: Column or columns of the HogQL query that make up the primary key. Required when IncrementalMode is `MERGE`.

VersionKey.description: Column or columns of the HogQL query that make up the version key.

IncrementalMode.description: How the batch export handles incremental updates: `APPEND` or `MERGE`.

Filters.description: Property filters restricting which events are exported, as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString) of HogQL property filters with type event, hogql or person, e.g. [{"key": "$browser", "operator": "exact", "type": "event", "value": ["Firefox"]}].

Timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. Europe/London) controlling daily and weekly interval boundaries. PostHog defaults to UTC.

OffsetDay.description: Day-of-week offset for weekly intervals (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday).

OffsetHour.description: Hour-of-day offset (0-23) for daily and weekly intervals.

StartAt.description: ISO 8601 time before which no runs are triggered.

EndAt.description: ISO 8601 time after which no runs are triggered.

LastUpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change.
